application.description: LedgerCat is a free, open-source desktop bookkeeping tool for small landlords: one portable Windows executable, local SQLite storage, CSV/JSON import-export. No install, no account, no cloud, no payments.
application.alreadyReleased: Yes - v1.0.1 is publicly released and distributed at https://neko.omegamc.uk/download/LedgerCat-1.0.1.exe with a SHA-256 checksum published on the download page.
application.activelyMaintained: Yes - active development, v1.1 in progress.
application.privacyStatement: This program will not transfer any information to other networked systems unless specifically requested by the user or the person installing or operating it.

thirdPartyComponents.name: .NET 8 runtime (self-contained publish)
thirdPartyComponents.note: System library as defined in GPL v3 section 1

application.notes: Single-maintainer project: Neko Omega writes and reviews code; the project owner approves every release and signing request. All team members use MFA on GitHub and SignPath.
